name: harness-verifies-its-launch
description: Incident 2026-11-11 bootstrap #6 (ADR 0270): runner-orca started Claude with `orca agent launch`, which added the owner's own `--permission-mode auto` over the factory's settings, and nothing checked the live process. A runner adapter must start the harness with the harness's own launch command and verify the live process against the launch record before it sends the prompt.
message: Start the harness with harness-claude's launch script (its exact argv), never a launcher that adds its own agent flags, and call verifyLaunch on the live process before sending the prompt; on any mismatch kill the session and fail the job with harness-config-mismatch. See .factory/checks/runner-adapters.md and ADR 0270.
